guide.description: > sends a command's stdout into a file, creating it or OVERWRITING it if it already exists. >> does the same but appends to the end instead, leaving existing content alone. Redirects run for real the moment you press Enter — they're not shown in the live speculative preview like a pure pipeline is, since they touch the filesystem.

flags.desc: overwrite the target file with stdout
append stdout to the end of the target file

examples.output: (nothing printed — it went to the file)
